fieldValues.title: A group's charter names the domains it holds
fieldValues.decision_question: How is a request routed to the right working group?
fieldValues.context: Raised 2026-10-16 in the owner's flow review (why nothing is moving): issues are parked until domains, problems and personas are established, and there was no rule for which group a grounded issue goes to. Complements D4 to D6 of clerk#57.
fieldValues.decision_statement: We model a group's boundary as the domains its charter names; a request placed in a domain goes to the input queue of the group that holds that domain, and a domain no group holds goes to the central group.
fieldValues.rationale: D4 places every request in a domain first and D5 routes it through a group's input queue; naming domains in the charter is the one link that makes the route mechanical. Answers the handbook open question whether a group's boundary maps to a domain.
fieldValues.revisit_when: A domain is held by two groups, or a group's work fits none of its named domains.
